easy: To miss a step and almost fall, or to fall down.

ex.en: She stumbled over a tree root on the hiking trail.

easy: To be the leader of a sports team.

ex.en: Mia captains our soccer team this year.
ex.ko: 미아가 올해 우리 축구팀의 주장을 맡고 있다.

easy: An animal that can become a father, like a rooster or a bull.

ex.en: The male lion has a big, thick mane.

easy: To see something, often after looking for it.

ex.en: I spotted a deer behind the trees.

easy: Not as well as before or as others.

ex.en: I did worse on the spelling test than last week.
ex.ko: 나는 지난주보다 철자 시험을 더 못 봤다.

easy: To give a prize or an honor to someone.

ex.en: The teacher awarded Ben a gold star for his hard work.
ex.ko: 선생님은 벤의 노력에 대해 금별 스티커를 주셨다.

easy: A solid piece of something with flat sides.

ex.en: He built a tall tower with wooden blocks.
ex.ko: 그는 나무 블록으로 높은 탑을 쌓았다.

easy: People who are not well and need care.

ex.en: The nurse takes care of the sick.

easy: A hidden problem that you do not see at first.

ex.en: The toy is free, but the catch is you must buy two.
ex.ko: 그 장난감은 공짜지만, 함정은 두 개를 사야 한다는 거다.

easy: Liked by many people, especially young people.

ex.en: She loves pop music and dances to it every day.
ex.ko: 그녀는 팝 음악을 좋아해서 매일 그 음악에 맞춰 춤춘다.

easy: Made of many parts that connect, so it is hard to understand.

ex.en: A clock is complex because it has many tiny parts.

easy: A time when someone asks a person many questions to learn about them.

ex.en: Our class did an interview with the school nurse.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 보건 선생님과 인터뷰를 했다.

easy: How much other people respect you or how important they think you are.

ex.en: Our coach has a good standing in town because everyone respects her.
ex.ko: 우리 코치님은 모두가 존경해서 마을에서 평판이 좋다.

easy: To stay away from someone or something.

ex.en: She distanced herself from the kids who were being mean.
ex.ko: 그녀는 못되게 구는 아이들과 거리를 두었다.

easy: To give something to someone and get something back.

ex.en: We exchanged snacks at the lunch table.

easy: A soft, oily stuff found in food and in bodies.

ex.en: Bacon has a lot of fat.

easy: To cut a tree so that it falls down.

ex.en: The woodcutter felled a huge oak tree.

easy: A hanging art piece with parts that move gently in the air.

ex.en: A paper bird mobile hangs over the baby's bed.
ex.ko: 아기 침대 위에 종이 새 모빌이 걸려 있다.

easy: A trip in a car.

ex.en: We went for a long ride to visit Grandma.
ex.ko: 우리는 할머니를 뵈러 차를 타고 멀리 갔다.

easy: In tennis and other games, the first hit that starts the play.

ex.en: Her serve flew over the net.

easy: To move less fast than before.

ex.en: The bus slowed down at the red light.

easy: A tall plant with a thick trunk, branches, and leaves.

ex.en: We climbed the big tree in the park.

easy: At the lowest place.

ex.en: My socks are in the bottom drawer.
ex.ko: 내 양말은 맨 아래 서랍에 있다.

easy: Something you say that is not true.

ex.en: Max told a lie about eating the cookies.
ex.ko: 맥스는 쿠키를 먹은 일에 대해 거짓말을 했다.

easy: Having four sides that are the same length and four corners like the corner of a book.

ex.en: Our classroom has a square rug.

easy: To carry people from one place to another on a big school-type vehicle.

ex.en: The kids were bused to the zoo.

easy: Number four in a line.

ex.en: My seat is in the fourth row.

easy: To get points in a game.

ex.en: Sam scored two goals in the soccer game.
ex.ko: 샘은 축구 경기에서 두 골을 넣었다.

easy: Not joined together; apart from others.

ex.en: The twins sleep in separate rooms.

easy: To come up to the top of the water.

ex.en: The whale surfaced near our boat.
ex.ko: 고래가 우리 배 가까이에서 물 위로 올라왔다.

easy: When you send a ball through the air with your arm.

ex.en: The catcher made a strong throw to second base.

easy: A short, light sound like a small piece of metal tapping.

ex.en: I heard the click of the key in the lock.

easy: To make something quickly from things you already have.

ex.en: She fashioned a hat out of paper.

easy: Money saved for a special purpose.

ex.en: Our class has a fund for the field trip.
ex.ko: 우리 반에는 현장 학습을 위한 기금이 있다.

easy: To lift something heavy with a special tool.

ex.en: Dad jacked up the car to fix the flat tire.
ex.ko: 아빠는 펑크 난 타이어를 고치려고 차를 잭으로 들어 올리셨다.

easy: Having a soft pink color, like some flowers.

ex.en: The sky glowed rose at sunrise.
ex.ko: 해가 뜰 때 하늘이 장밋빛으로 빛났다.

easy: To show someone where to sit.

ex.en: The teacher seated me next to Mia.

easy: Kind and ready to see how others feel.

ex.en: My coach is understanding when I make mistakes.
ex.ko: 우리 코치님은 내가 실수해도 이해해 주신다.

easy: A number bigger than 1 that only 1 and itself can divide evenly, like 7.

ex.en: Seven is a prime number because only 1 and 7 divide it evenly.

easy: To make a loud, clear sound, like a bell.

ex.en: The school bell rang loudly.

easy: When something becomes more or bigger.

ex.en: There was a rise in the number of kids at our school.

easy: Made of a shiny gray-white metal.

ex.en: Grandma gave me a silver ring.

easy: Things nobody wants anymore, so they are thrown away.

ex.en: The truck takes our waste away every Monday.

easy: Nature, where people do not live or build.

ex.en: Wolves live in the wild.

easy: All the actors in a play.

ex.en: The whole cast bowed at the end of our school play.
ex.ko: 우리 학교 연극이 끝나자 출연진 모두가 인사했다.

easy: To dig and turn over soil so seeds can be planted.

ex.en: The farmer tilled the field before planting corn.
ex.ko: 농부는 옥수수를 심기 전에 밭을 갈았다.

easy: Number five in a line.

ex.en: She sits in the fifth row.

easy: Fresh fruits and vegetables that farmers grow to sell.

ex.en: We buy fresh produce at the farmers market.
ex.ko: 우리는 농산물 시장에서 신선한 채소와 과일을 산다.

easy: To get better little by little.

ex.en: Jin progressed quickly in piano class.
ex.ko: 진은 피아노 수업에서 빠르게 실력이 늘었다.

easy: To write down exactly what you see.

ex.en: I copied the words from the board.

easy: To grow flowers or plants in a garden.

ex.en: Grandpa gardens every weekend.

easy: To work very hard to reach a goal.

ex.en: She labored for hours on her art project.
ex.ko: 그녀는 미술 숙제를 하느라 몇 시간 동안 애썼다.

easy: A piece of clothing for a girl or woman with a top and skirt in one piece.

ex.en: She wore a red dress to the party.
ex.ko: 그녀는 파티에 빨간 원피스를 입고 갔다.

easy: A paper that asks someone in charge for something.

ex.en: Our class sent a request to the principal for a new playground.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 새 놀이터를 요청하는 글을 교장 선생님께 보냈다.

easy: A thin, long piece of wood.

ex.en: He collected dry sticks for a campfire.
ex.ko: 그는 모닥불을 피우려고 마른 막대기를 모았다.

easy: A thousand million, which is 1 followed by nine zeros.

ex.en: There are about eight billion people on Earth.

easy: A place with fields, barns, and animals where food is grown.

ex.en: We picked apples at a farm.

easy: A group of papers or computer records kept together.

ex.en: I saved my homework in a file on the computer.

easy: A small insect with two wings that buzzes around food.

ex.en: A fly landed on my sandwich.
ex.ko: 파리 한 마리가 내 샌드위치에 앉았다.

easy: To make someone feel shocked in a sudden way.

ex.en: We surprised Mom with a birthday cake.
ex.ko: 우리는 생일 케이크로 엄마를 깜짝 놀라게 했다.

easy: A special food that tastes very good.

ex.en: Ice cream is my favorite treat.

easy: To take the water out of something so it is not wet.

ex.en: Mom dried the wet towels in the sun.

easy: Very bad behavior that hurts other people.

ex.en: The story shows good winning over evil.
ex.ko: 그 이야기는 선이 악을 이기는 모습을 보여준다.

easy: To make clothes smooth and flat with a hot tool.

ex.en: Dad ironed my school shirt.
ex.ko: 아빠가 내 학교 셔츠를 다려 주셨다.

easy: To watch over something to keep it safe.

ex.en: The dog guards our house at night.

easy: To say a little about something.

ex.en: Ellie mentioned her new puppy at lunch.
ex.ko: 엘리는 점심시간에 새 강아지 이야기를 꺼냈다.

easy: A new, small part growing out of a plant.

ex.en: A green shoot pushed up through the soil.

easy: To say that something is very important.

ex.en: Our teacher stressed that we should check our work.
ex.ko: 선생님은 우리가 답을 다시 확인해야 한다고 강조하셨다.

easy: To have a certain flavor.

ex.en: This soup tastes like garlic.

easy: A car that runs on electric power instead of gas.

ex.en: Our neighbor drives an electric car.

easy: To send a letter or package through the post office.

ex.en: I mailed a card to Grandma.

easy: Two things that go together.

ex.en: I got a new pair of shoes.
ex.ko: 나는 새 신발 한 켤레를 샀다.

easy: To change how something grows or turns out.

ex.en: Good books can shape the way you think.
ex.ko: 좋은 책은 네가 생각하는 방식에 영향을 줄 수 있다.

easy: Moving something from one place to another.

ex.en: The transfer of the boxes to the truck took an hour.
ex.ko: 상자를 트럭으로 옮기는 데 한 시간이 걸렸다.

easy: Higher up; the top one of two.

ex.en: I sleep in the upper bunk.

easy: A big, strong animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

ex.en: A bear caught a fish in the river.

easy: A bag of dry ingredients that is ready to make food.

ex.en: Dad made pancakes from a mix.

easy: Words you say that you will do something later.

ex.en: I made a promise to walk the dog every day.

easy: When water falls from the clouds.

ex.en: It rained all day, so we played inside.
ex.ko: 하루 종일 비가 와서 우리는 안에서 놀았다.

easy: To get your mind ready for something hard.

ex.en: She steeled herself before jumping into the cold pool.
ex.ko: 그녀는 차가운 수영장에 뛰어들기 전에 마음을 단단히 먹었다.

easy: To become hotter than before.

ex.en: The milk warmed on the stove.

easy: To be the boss who gives orders to a group.

ex.en: The captain commands the ship.

easy: A large group of people or things together.

ex.en: A big crowd cheered at the game.

easy: To show respect and give a prize to someone.

ex.en: The school honored the kids who helped clean the park.
ex.ko: 학교는 공원 청소를 도운 아이들을 표창했다.

easy: Between noon and midnight.

ex.en: School ends at 3 p.m.

easy: New information or a new version of a program.

ex.en: My tablet needs a new update.

easy: The color of a banana or a sunflower.

ex.en: Yellow is the color of a banana.

easy: To change to the color of a banana.

ex.en: Leaves yellow in the fall.

easy: To send a message by computer.

ex.en: I emailed my homework to my teacher.

easy: Mail that gets there much faster than normal mail.

ex.en: The package came by express mail.

easy: Clearly said, not just guessed.

ex.en: Dad's express rule is to wear a helmet.
ex.ko: 아빠의 분명한 규칙은 헬멧을 쓰는 것이다.

easy: To move along smoothly like water.

ex.en: The river flows past our school.

easy: To say funny things to make people laugh.

ex.en: My brother jokes at dinner.
ex.ko: 우리 형은 저녁 식사 때 농담을 한다.

easy: To put sweet white crystals on food or drink.

ex.en: I sugared my cereal.

easy: To carry people or things from one place to another.

ex.en: Trucks transport food to stores.

easy: Food for farm animals.

ex.en: The farmer gave the cows feed.

easy: Money that is given to help pay for something.

ex.en: The school got a grant to buy new books.
ex.ko: 학교는 새 책을 사기 위한 보조금을 받았다.

easy: To think someone or something is another one by accident.

ex.en: I mistook a stick for a snake.

easy: To put things together so everyone can use them.

ex.en: We pooled our money to buy a gift.
ex.ko: 우리는 선물을 사려고 돈을 함께 모았다.

easy: To make a sound with your voice because something is funny.

ex.en: I laughed so hard that milk came out of my nose.
ex.ko: 나는 너무 크게 웃어서 코로 우유가 나왔다.

easy: To take milk from a cow or other animal.

ex.en: Farmers milk the cows every morning.

easy: When white, soft flakes fall from the sky.

ex.en: It snowed all night, so school was closed.

easy: Very strong wind with rain, thunder, and lightning.

ex.en: The storm knocked down a big tree.

easy: Coming before the time it is needed.

ex.en: We got advance notice about the test.
ex.ko: 우리는 시험에 대해 미리 안내를 받았다.

easy: A person who makes food.

ex.en: The school cook made soup.

easy: To find out how long, tall, or heavy something is.

ex.en: I measured my height against the door.
ex.ko: 나는 문에 대고 내 키를 쟀다.

easy: To get less noisy.

ex.en: The class quieted when the teacher walked in.

easy: To cut or break something into parts.

ex.en: We split the pizza into eight slices.

easy: A talk where people give reasons for and against an idea.

ex.en: Our class had a debate about school lunches.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 급식에 대해 토론을 했다.

easy: To run away from a place where you were kept.

ex.en: The hamster escaped from its cage.
